page.label: Due Thursday, September 10
page.text: History does not meet Tuesday this week (schedule change: Thursday runs Tuesday's lineup). Reread Aquinas' Prayer Before Study, the handout from the first day. Unit 2 opens Thursday at 7:20 in Faustina: Spain.

page.label: Due Friday, September 11
page.text: Read and annotate The Death of El Cid (binder p. 19): the Five Ws plus at least two of your own margin questions. Friday is a source seminar; your annotations are the ticket.

page.label: Monday, September 21
page.text: Map quiz on Spain. Start the blank map this week; ten minutes with it a few nights a week is the whole plan.

glance.text: reread the Aquinas prayer. No History Tuesday; Unit 2 opens Thursday at 7:20.
The Death of El Cid (binder p. 19), annotated, with two of your own questions.

page.label: Due Wednesday, September 9
page.text: Read Matthew 8:1 to 12:50. Annotate 9:9 to 13 and bring one written question. There is no Theology class Tuesday this week; Wednesday is our first meeting, then Thursday and Friday.

page.label: Thursday, September 10
page.text: Quiz on Matthew 1 to 12 at the start of class (Period 3, 10:00). Due the same day: Matthew 13:1 to 53, read and annotated. Count the parables as you read.

page.label: Due Friday, September 11
page.text: Read Matthew 13:54 to 16:12. Annotate 15:21 to 28 with your honest reaction. This is one night's reading, so start it over the weekend if you can.

glance.text: Matthew 8 to 12; annotate 9:9 to 13. No class Tuesday.
quiz on Matthew 1 to 12, and Matthew 13:1 to 53 due.

page.label: Due Wednesday, September 9
page.text: Read through Canto XI. Annotate X and XI: the sin, the contrapasso, the sinners. Wednesday is a written period: the comprehension questions on X and XI are done in class, open book, and then we start Canto XII. Bring one written discussion question on Cantos IX to XI.

page.label: Thursday and Friday, September 10 and 11
page.text: Thursday is a reading day: Cantos XII and XIII in class, finished at home, with a discussion question for Friday. Friday: discussion, then the second Super Simile paragraph (the Harpies) in class.

page.label: Monday, September 14
page.text: Quiz on Cantos I to XIII: for every circle, the sin, the contrapasso, the sinners. Look back over your annotations this weekend.

page.label: Super Simile
page.text: Paragraph 1 is in your folder. Paragraph 2, the Harpies, is written in class Friday, September 11.

glance.text: read through Canto XI; the questions on X and XI in class, open book; one discussion question on IX to XI.
quiz on Cantos I to XIII.
Sections are announced at Tuesday's rehearsal. Next rehearsal Thursday, September 10 at 2:03. Friday, September 11 is the first all-school Friday sing; the choir leads it.
